newsitem.title: USA: Kerr Group says Fremont extends tender offer.
newsitem.headline: Kerr Group says Fremont extends tender offer.

text.p: Package products maker Kerr Group said Monday that Freemont Partners has extended the cash tender deadline for shares of Kerr until midnight EDT August 18.
The company said the extension was made to allow discussions among Freemont, Kerr, senior debt holders of Kerr and the Pension Benefit Guaranty Corp (PBGC).
Previously, Kerr said that the PBGC, which runs its retirement plan, intended to apply to a U.S. district court for an order to terminate the plan.
Kerr said the PBGC took the action to protect its interests in connection with the tender offer from Freemont.

Kerr said that as of Friday August 15, 89 percent of its outstanding common stock; 61 percent of oustanding preferred stock; and 77 percent of common stock on an as-converted, fully-diluted basis, have been tendered to Freemont.
